youtube_description:
Paul Pogba and Bruno Fernandes inspired a second half Man United comeback in a 1-1 draw with Spurs. Pogba's introduction with Mason Greenwood on 60 minutes helped swing the game in United's favour after David de Gea and Harry Maguire's mistakes allowed Steven Bergwijn to give Spurs the lead in the first half. After 100 days without football, United fans will be largely happy with the draw but United's dominance deserved more in that second half.
